speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs (a) whether he can provide an update on the progress of the SCDF emergency preparedness exercise and rollout of SGSecure in condominiums and private estates; and (b) whether there are plans to place automated external defibrillators (AEDs) at public spaces in private estates.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: SGSecure programmes are accessible to everyone, whether they stay in public or private housing.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: An example is the Emergency Preparedness (EP) Day event held at various locations across the island.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: EP Days are conducted at public areas with high human traffic and all are welcome to attend.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
text: Other outreach activities include school assembly talks and counter-terrorism seminars and exercises in workplaces and religious organisations.

speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
text: I have two supplementary questions for the Senior Parliamentary Secretary.

speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
text: The first one is: we know that condominiums are confined communities, so are there trials or tests that are being done to see how prepared they are in times of emergencies?

speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (Fengshan)
text: The second question is: how can the community play a more active role to help in the rollout of the entire CPR/AED programme?

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: On the first question, emergency preparedness is an ongoing and whole-of-society effort.

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: We do not specifically track the emergency preparedness of condominiums.

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: However, surveys, such as the national security awareness survey, have found that our residents are generally aware of the different emergency scenarios that they might encounter, and our residents have also been taking practical steps to prepare themselves to respond to an emergency situation, such as by having a first-aid kit at home.

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: A vast majority, over 90%, also believe that everyone has a role to play in ensuring our nation's safety and security and are willing to help during emergencies.

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: These are encouraging findings, but we can always do more to raise the level of preparedness.

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: That is why the Home Team is working with the People's Association (PA) to identify condominiums to ensure that the message gets to them.

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: On the second question on what part the community can play, the installation of more AEDs, be it in HDB or private estates, will only be effective if residents know how to use it, are able to use it and respond in emergency situations.

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: Our grassroots volunteers are an important group of people who are not only the community first responders, but they can also help to encourage other residents to pick up CPR/AED skills through programmes, such as the Emergency Preparedness Day.

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: It is in all our interests to ensure that this programmes succeeds.

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: So, the message is for all residents to open their doors to our Home Team officers to ensure that they are able to receive the CPR/AED training.

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: We would need to look at, for example, the location and condominiums where the AEDs can be installed at publicly accessible security posts.

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: These are factors that will be taken into account.

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: We will also need to see the type of management and how receptive they are, and we would encourage condominiums to also maintain their AEDs and equip some of their residents with CPR/AED skills.

speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
text: We will work closely, as I mentioned, with the grassroots advisers, neighbourhood committees and the management corporation strata titles.
